liquid_market_row.eventDescription: One Kalshi event contract that has actually traded — non-zero volume or open interest — with yes/no bid and ask, last price, implied probability, volume, 24h volume, open interest, liquidity, close time, and resolution rules. Empty searches and unknown tickers are free. First 2 rows per run are free.

market_row.eventDescription: One Kalshi event contract market with no trading activity yet — zero volume and zero open interest — with the same fields as a traded market. Priced unchanged at the previous flat rate. Empty searches and unknown tickers are free. First 2 rows per run are free.
